name: chloerestaurant
description: ChloeRestaurant — Sistema de gestión para restaurantes
author: ChloeRestaurant

scripts.electron:pack: npm run build:server --prefix .. && vite build && npm run predist && electron-builder --dir
scripts.predist: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const srcExe=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'..','ServidorPOS.exe'); const dstExe=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'ServidorPOS.exe'); if(fs.existsSync(srcExe)){ fs.copyFileSync(srcExe,dstExe); } const srcCjs=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'..','bundle.cjs'); const dstCjs=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'ServidorPOS.cjs'); if(fs.existsSync(srcCjs)){ fs.copyFileSync(srcCjs,dstCjs); } const srcEnv=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'..','.env.electron'); const dstEnv=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'.env'); if(fs.existsSync(srcEnv)){ fs.copyFileSync(srcEnv,dstEnv); } const dstPg=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'build','postgresql-installer.exe'); if(!fs.existsSync(dstPg)){ const pgCandidates=[path.resolve(process.cwd(),'..','postgresql-18.4-2-windows-x64.exe'),'C:/Users/Administrador/Downloads/postgresql-18.4-2-windows-x64.exe','C:/Users/Administrador/Downloads/Programs/postgresql-18.4-2-windows-x64.exe']; for(const c of pgCandidates){ if(fs.existsSync(c)){ fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dstPg),{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(c,dstPg); break; } } }"
scripts.dist: npm run build:server --prefix .. && vite build && npm run predist && electron-builder && npm run postdist
scripts.postdist: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const fileExe=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'ServidorPOS.exe'); if(fs.existsSync(fileExe)){ fs.unlinkSync(fileExe); } const fileCjs=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'ServidorPOS.cjs'); if(fs.existsSync(fileCjs)){ fs.unlinkSync(fileCjs); } const fileEnv=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'.env'); if(fs.existsSync(fileEnv)){ fs.unlinkSync(fileEnv); } const filePg=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'build','postgresql-installer.exe'); if(fs.existsSync(filePg)){ fs.unlinkSync(filePg); }"
